title: Page 2
content_zh:
“欸，你有没有看今天的水果日报？”
“你是说我们少东跟那个金控千金约会被拍到的事啊？”
“嗯，你不觉得他们很配吗？不论外型、家世都是完美的组合耶！”
“是啊！我就觉得这个孙小姐很适合当我们未来的老板娘。”
几人七嘴八舌的讨论着，还故意把报纸上徐士凯跟那位孙小姐的亲密合照摊开。
范蕙怡看着那张照片，果然是男的英俊，女的柔美，超完美组合，她一点都不意外，她甚至知道那个金控千金叫孙依依，是徐士凯打小就认识的青梅竹马，两家还是世交，然而尽管如此，看见他温柔搭在孙依依腰间的手还是让她的心一阵紧缩。
不过她没让情绪表现在脸上。
她知道那些人当面讲这些事情的目的是什么，她们想看她的反应，无论是伤心、忌妒，她都不愿意让她们看见，让她们称心如意。
其实她们又何必这样苦苦相逼，没有人比她更了解自己跟他有多么不配。她自嘲的想。
“这笔款项你们汇错了，正确金额应该是这样。”范蕙怡把文件放在负责的会计桌上。“希望你今天之内可以改正过来。”
她的语气淡淡的，没有情绪起伏，可是她处理的文件总是完美无瑕，数字永远像机器跑出来的一样无误，所以虽然对于这个平常就不喜欢跟她们哈拉的董事助理没啥好感，负责的会计也只能心虚的看了眼被指正的数字，然后点点头。“是、是的。”
范蕙怡转身离开以后那个负责的会计被同事围剿。
“你干么对她那么卑躬屈膝？”
“对嘛！徐总已经甩了她，现在我们不用忌惮她的身分了。”
“可、可是……”那会计缩着肩，小小声的说：“就算这样，她讲的还是有道理嘛，我真的做错了。”
范蕙怡根本就不管身后的那些骚动，她回到自己的办公室，这时候上司已经来了。
熟练的泡好咖啡，掌握精准的热度跟浓度，她把一迭报表连同咖啡端进董事办公室。
“您早，这是您的咖啡。”
“谢谢。”徐雪龄是个和和气气的中年妇人，优雅稳重的气质来自于大家族的熏陶，她对范蕙怡极好，几乎把她当成女儿一样疼爱。
范蕙怡把文件按照重要顺序摆放好，在待签名的地方标示清楚，一如以往，她细心又干练。

徐雪龄边喝咖啡边看着她，早上的报纸也不知道她看了没有？看到她那个笨侄子的花边新闻她又急又气，士凯怎么会抛弃像蕙怡这么好的女孩子？蕙怡一定很受伤吧？可偏偏这些日子以来她一切都很正常，正常得反而不太正常了。
“蕙怡，你要不要休个几天假，去散散心什么的？”徐雪龄试探的问。
范蕙怡动作停了下来。“为什么您要这么说？是我最近工作上有出什么状况让您不满意吗？”
被她那过于清醒的眼睛直视着，徐雪龄反而有些尴尬不安。
“没有，当然没有，你一直都做得很好。”就是这样才让人更加担心。“我只是觉得你不要把什么事都闷在心里，偶尔放松一下没有关系，大哭一场，或者把对方大骂一顿都没关系，发泄出来，这样会好过一点。”
范蕙怡低着头。“我没事，谢谢您的关心。”
“可是——”
徐雪龄还想劝她几句，但范蕙怡却微微欠身说道，“还有工作，我先出去了，有事您再叫我。”
徐雪龄看着她挺直的背脊，只能摇头叹息。蕙怡的倔强让她不由得心疼，可是却又不知道该怎么安慰她。
范蕙怡快步走出董事办公室，她没有回到自己的办公桌，反而大步冲进另一头的洗手间，把自己锁进隔间里才捂住脸。
会计部那些女生们的冷嘲热讽伤不了她，徐雪龄的温言关切却让她几乎崩溃。她想象她说的那样大哭大骂一场，但是从小就不是这样个性的她根本就不知道该怎么哭、怎么骂。
这孩子，搞不懂她在想什么，老是一张扑克脸。
她想起妈妈曾经皱着眉这么对朋友说她，然后转头看妹妹的时候却满是宠溺的笑容。虽然她的功课比妹妹好、做的家事比妹妹多，也更听话，可是却没有妹妹来得会撒娇、会装无辜，所以也无法得到妈妈的疼爱。
小时候她还会觉得不公平，常常为妈妈的偏心偷偷哭泣，长大后却渐渐接受这个事实。她相信自己就是不可爱，无法得到人们的喜爱。
直到徐士凯硬是闯进她的世界，告诉她并非没有人爱她……
只不过最终仍然是一场空！
算了，没差，她只要再回到过去就好了，当作没发生过这些事，当作没认识那个男人。她不知道自己能不能做到，不知道要多久才能做到，不过现实就是现实，她该学会面对它。
走出厕所隔间，对着镜子整理一下自己，她深吸口气。
争气点，范蕙怡！
走出洗手间时，她的表情多了一份坚定。

回到办公室，奇怪的气氛让她一愣。徐雪龄神色惊慌，看到她的时候眼泪都快掉下来了。
“蕙怡！”
“怎么了？您还好吧？发生什么事了？”从没看过上司这种样子，范蕙怡心里有种不好的预感。
“士凯……他出车祸了！”
刚听到这个消息的时候她脑袋空空的，一下子接受不了这个事实，所以当徐雪龄牵起她的手往外走的时候，她乖乖的跟着走了几步。
“董事，你要带我去哪里？”
“去医院啊！”徐雪龄理所当然的说。“士凯的状况也不知道怎样，他如果清醒的话一定很想见你。”
徐雪龄的最后一句话让范蕙怡一下子清醒了过来，她止住步伐。“不，我不用去。”
徐雪龄不可置信的回头。“为什么？”
“我不是他的谁，而且我相信他也不会想再看到我了。”
徐雪龄闻言一僵，看到她眉眼间一闪而过的苦涩，这才想起他们已经分手。
“呃……也对喔。”她呐呐的放开她的手。
在徐雪龄转身急着去看侄子的时候，范蕙怡忍不住又出声唤住她。
“董事！”
“嗯？”
“可不可以麻烦你知道他的状况以后告诉我？拜托。”范蕙怡恳求，她的表情难得的显现出慌乱、恐惧、无助，还有真切的关心。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
“没问题，我会的。”
给了这个保证，徐雪龄才匆匆走出办公室。
其实徐雪龄一走，范蕙怡就开始后悔了。

她好想跟她一起去医院，不管徐士凯看到她是什么反应，不管别人会不会说她太多事甚至厚脸皮，她都不在乎，只要看他一眼，确定他没事就好了……
第1章(2)
不知道过了多久，就在她几乎要抓起皮包往外走时——那会是她工作以来第一次不假外出，她接到徐雪龄的电话。
“董事，怎么样？他——”看到来电显示，她立刻接了起来，紧张的追问。
“状况不是很好，全身多处骨折，现在送进手术室做紧急手术。”
范蕙怡的心都凉了，全身不断颤抖。
“你也不要过于担心，”最后安慰她的反而是徐雪龄，范蕙怡根本就已经哽咽的说不出话来。“我们会确保他得到最好的照顾，他的主治医生是国内的外科权威，他又还那么年轻、体力那么好，我想他应该不会有事的。”
她当然不怀疑他家族的能耐，只是要她放心还是不可能。
content_en:
"Hey, have you read today's Fruit Daily?"
"Are you talking about the time our Shaodong was photographed on a date with that finance-controlled daughter?"
"Well, don't you think they match well? They are a perfect combination in terms of appearance and family background!"
"Yes! I think this Miss Sun is very suitable to be our future boss lady."
Several people were discussing in a flurry, and even deliberately spread out the intimate photo of Xu Shikai and Miss Sun in the newspaper.
Fan Huiyi looked at the photo, and it turned out that the man was handsome and the woman was soft, a perfect combination. She was not surprised at all. She even knew that the wealthy daughter was called Sun Yiyi. She was Xu Shikai's childhood sweetheart since she was a child. The two families were family friends. However, despite this, her heart tightened when she saw his gentle hand on Sun Yiyi's waist.
But she didn't let her emotions show on her face.
She knew the purpose of those people telling these things face to face. They wanted to see her reaction. Whether it was sadness or jealousy, she didn't want them to see it so that they could get what they wanted.
In fact, why should they be so hard on each other? No one knows better than her how unworthy she is of him. She thought mockingly.
"You remitted the wrong amount. The correct amount should be this." Fan Huiyi put the document on the responsible accountant's desk. "I hope you can make things right within today."
Her tone was light and there was no emotional ups and downs, but the documents she processed were always flawless, and the numbers were always as accurate as the ones coming out of the machine. So although she didn't like this assistant director who usually didn't like to talk to them, the accountant in charge could only look at the corrected numbers with a guilty conscience, and then nodded. "Y-yes."
After Fan Huiyi turned around and left, the responsible accountant was surrounded by colleagues.
"Why are you so groveling to her?"
"That's right! Mr. Xu has dumped her, now we don't have to worry about her identity."
"B-but..." The accountant hunched his shoulders and said in a low voice: "Even so, what she said still makes sense. I really did something wrong."
Fan Huiyi didn't care about the commotion behind her. She returned to her office, and her boss had already arrived.
Skillfully brewing the coffee, mastering the precise heat and concentration, she brought a stack of reports and the coffee into the director's office.
"Good morning, here's your coffee."
"Thank you." Xu Xueling is a kind-hearted middle-aged woman. Her elegant and steady temperament comes from the influence of a large family. She treats Fan Huiyi very well and loves her almost as a daughter.
Fan Huiyi arranged the documents in order of importance and clearly marked the places to be signed. As always, she was careful and capable.
Xu Xueling looked at her while drinking coffee. I wonder if she had read the morning newspaper? She was anxious and angry after seeing the tidbits about her stupid nephew. How could Shikai abandon a good girl like Hui Yi? Hui Yi must be very hurt, right? But it happened that everything had been normal for her these days, so normal that it seemed not normal at all.
"Hui Yi, do you want to take a few days off to relax or something?" Xu Xueling asked tentatively.
Fan Huiyi stopped moving. "Why do you say that? Is there something that happened to me at work recently that made you dissatisfied?"
Staring directly at her too sober eyes, Xu Xueling felt a little embarrassed and uneasy.
"No, of course not, you've always done a good job." That's what makes people even more worried. "I just think you shouldn't keep everything in your mind. It doesn't matter if you relax occasionally. It doesn't matter if you cry a lot or scold the other person. Let it out. It will make you feel better."
Fan Huiyi lowered her head. "I'm fine, thank you for your concern."
"But-"
Xu Xueling wanted to persuade her a few words, but Fan Huiyi leaned forward slightly and said, "I still have work to do. I'll go out first. If you need anything, call me again."
Xu Xueling looked at her straightening upI could only shake my head and sigh. Hui Yi's stubbornness made her feel distressed, but she didn't know how to comfort her.
Fan Huiyi walked out of the director's office quickly. Instead of returning to her desk, she strode into the bathroom at the other end and locked herself in the cubicle before covering her face.
The cynicism of the girls in the accounting department couldn't hurt her, but Xu Xueling's gentle words and concerns made her almost collapse. She imagined crying and cursing like she said, but she had not been this kind of personality since she was a child and didn't know how to cry or scold at all.
This kid, I can't figure out what she's thinking, he always has a poker face.
She remembered that her mother once said this to her friends with a frown, and then turned to look at her sister with a doting smile. Although she does better homework than her younger sister, does more housework, and is more obedient, she is not as coquettish or as innocent as her younger sister, so she cannot get her mother's love.
When she was a child, she still felt it was unfair and often secretly cried for her mother's favoritism. However, as she grew up, she gradually accepted this fact. She believed that she was just unlovable and could not be liked by people.
Until Xu Shikai broke into her world and told her that no one loved her...
But in the end it was still all in vain!
Forget it, it's okay, she just needs to go back to the past and pretend that these things never happened and that she never knew that man. She didn't know if she could do it, or how long it would take to do it, but reality was reality, and she should learn to face it.
She walked out of the bathroom stall, straightened herself out in the mirror, and took a deep breath.
Be brave, Fan Huiyi!
When she walked out of the bathroom, her expression became more determined.
When she returned to the office, she was startled by the strange atmosphere. Xu Xueling looked panicked and almost burst into tears when she saw her.
"Hui Yi!"
"What's wrong? Are you okay? What happened?" Fan Huiyi had never seen her boss like this before, and she had a bad feeling in her heart.
"Shikai...he was in a car accident!"
When she first heard the news, her head was empty and she couldn't accept the fact at once, so when Xu Xueling took her hand and walked out, she followed him for a few steps obediently.
"Director, where are you taking me?"
"Go to the hospital!" Xu Xueling said matter-of-factly. "I don't know what Shikai's condition is. If he is awake, he will definitely want to see you."
Xu Xueling's last words made Fan Huiyi wake up suddenly, and she stopped walking. "No, I don't have to go."
Xu Xueling turned around in disbelief. "Why?"
"I'm not his, and I'm sure he won't want to see me again."
Xu Xueling froze when she heard this, and when she saw the bitterness flashing between her eyebrows, she remembered that they had broken up.
"Uh...that's right." She let go of her hand.
When Xu Xueling turned around and rushed to see her nephew, Fan Huiyi couldn't help calling her out again.
"Director!"
"Huh?"
"Can you please tell me after you know his condition? Please." Fan Huiyi begged, her expression rarely showed panic, fear, helplessness, and real concern.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
"No problem, I will."
After giving this guarantee, Xu Xueling hurriedly walked out of the office.
In fact, as soon as Xu Xueling left, Fan Huiyi began to regret it.
She really wanted to go to the hospital with her. No matter how Xu Shikai reacted when he saw her, no matter whether others would say that she was too busy or even shameless, she didn't care. She just wanted to take a look at him and make sure that he was fine...
Chapter 1(2)
She didn't know how long it had passed, but just when she was about to grab her purse and go out - it would be the first time she went out without a break since working, she received a call from Xu Xueling.
"Director, how's it going? He -" Seeing the caller ID, she immediately picked up the call and asked nervously.
"The condition is not very good. He has multiple fractures all over his body. He is now sent to the operating room for emergency surgery."
Fan Huiyi's heart went cold and her whole body was shaking.
"Don't worry too much," it was Xu Xueling who comforted her in the end. Fan Huiyi was choked up and speechless. "We will ensure that he gets the best care. His attending doctor is a leading surgical authority in the country. He is still so young and in good physical condition. I think he will be fine."
Of course she didn't doubt his family's ability, but it was still impossible for her to rest assured.
